Runtime dependencies in the Android prototype

NanoHTTPD 2.3.1 — BSD-3-Clause — https://github.com/NanoHttpd/nanohttpd
ZXing core 3.5.3 — Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/zxing/zxing
Kotlin standard library 1.9.24 — Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin
JetBrains annotations (transitive) — Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/JetBrains/java-annotations

License files are bundled here and in the Android APK's assets.
Android and Apple platform APIs are supplied by the operating systems.
The source archive also includes the Gradle 8.9 wrapper (Apache-2.0),
which retains its license headers: https://github.com/gradle/gradle
